bio: Beautiful 4 star spa hotel nestled in mature woodlands, choose either the elegant Terrace or stylish FYR Restaurant and Grill in which to enjoy your afternoon tea – created by their own Pastry Chef  The menu celebrates the best of the season – with unique twists and using only the freshest local ingredients.  The Terrace is the best place to enjoy Afternoon Tea, overlooking the stylish Meadow and Petanque court, and enjoying a sunny vista.
